issues.detail: The Greek word 'κοινωσαι' (koinosai) means 'to make common', 'to share', or 'to communicate'. The Vietnamese translation uses 'làm dơ dáy' (to defile/make unclean), which is a theological interpretation but not the literal meaning of the Greek word used in this specific verse (Matthew 15:19). The Greek text describes what enters/leaves the person as 'common' (shared) to the person, not necessarily 'defiled'.
